sentences.en: We left Hulton Friday night and arrived here Saturday morning.

sentences.en: It's a good thing tomorrow is Saturday.

sentences.en: This would be one Saturday she wouldn't have to crawl out of bed and get ready to go to the diner.

sentences.en: A weekly market on Saturday granted by Richard I.

sentences.en: Quinn asked the question over oatmeal and raisin toast on Saturday morning.

sentences.en: We would meet the young girl on Saturday.

sentences.en: On Saturday the 12th of August he rode into Louyset, a village on the French side of Geneva.

sentences.en: I've got a black and blue mark on my ribs from his version of Saturday night fever.

sentences.en: You guys excited about shopping Saturday?

sentences.en: On Saturday Carmen left Alex with Jonathan and Destiny, heading for the old house.
sentences.vi: Vào thứ bảy, Carmen rời Alex với Jonathan và Destiny, hướng về ngôi nhà cũ.
